{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm
mean_flipper_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the result
print(highest_mean_species)

# Print the full mean values for transparency
print('\nMean flipper lengths by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)"}
